voice.searchph: Search the collection: components, tokens, patterns
voice.copyfail: That slipped - select the code instead
voice.hero.p: Every token, component and pattern behind heyrav.in - painted, framed and put to work.
voice.lede.worlds: One system, many worlds. Here classical paint meets modern parts: the same components, laid over a Renaissance sky like a collage.
voice.lede.typography: Instrument Sans sets the titles, crisp and modern; Cormorant Garamond carries the italic accent and the statements; EB Garamond - a face cut in the 1500s - carries the reading.
voice.lede.colour: Putty-stone and olive-black by day, a painted night by dark; violet for what acts, hot pink when something goes right. Every text colour clears 4.5:1.
voice.lede.spacing: Gallery spacing: every step a little wider than Studio's, so each piece hangs with room around it.
voice.lede.radius: Small, exact corners on the modern parts; the paintings keep their frames square.
voice.lede.elevation: Off-white panels rest on putty with a soft, warm shadow, like prints laid on a table.
voice.lede.motion: Smooth and composed, with a small lift at the end. Reduced motion keeps every painting still.
voice.lede.icons: Phosphor Regular: modern line icons, laid over classical paint.
voice.lede.button: A violet pill, the modern part of the collage. A success throws gold leaf and a little pink.
voice.lede.voice: Composed and a little grand, never stiff. Every label still says exactly what it does.
voice.lede.404: This piece is not in the collection. Search, or start again from the first room.
voice.type.head: titles
voice.type.head.note: Instrument Sans: crisp, modern, tightly set - the new laid over the old.
voice.type.sans.note: EB Garamond: a Renaissance roman revived, made for long reading.
voice.type.em.note: Cormorant Garamond italic, set inside a modern title the way Ren-ai-ssance is.
voice.type.label: labels
voice.type.label.note: Instrument Sans, small and firm, in sentence case.
voice.lede.chip: Small tags; chosen, a tag turns olive-black, like the labels pinned to a gallery wall.
voice.lede.badge: Small grotesk tags; the solid one is olive-black.
voice.lede.card: An off-white print in a hairline frame, with a fine inner rule; under the pointer it lifts.
voice.lede.input: A white field in a hairline frame; focus draws a violet ring.
voice.lede.checkbox: A small square; checked, it fills violet and throws a flake of gold leaf.
voice.lede.switch: A pill in olive and violet, the thumb an off-white bead.
voice.lede.slider: A fine rule filled in violet, with an off-white bead to hold.
voice.lede.tabs: Sentence-case grotesk; the chosen tab is underlined in violet.
voice.lede.accordion: A grotesk heading; the answer opens in Garamond.
voice.lede.dialog: An off-white print over a dimmed room, rising into place.
voice.lede.toast: An olive-black tag that slides in; good news throws gold leaf.
voice.lede.skeleton: A soft shimmer over putty where content will be.
voice.lede.avatar: A hairline frame, like a portrait in a gallery.
voice.lede.link: Violet underlined words; under the pointer the underline thickens.
voice.lede.menu: An off-white list; the item in focus is lit in violet.
voice.lede.morph: Commission it: a violet arc while it is painted, Finished with gold leaf and pink, then the piece is shown.
